briefs.text: Singapore-China JCBC council sits Monday; no deliverables published yet
US futures bounced in Asia hours; Nasdaq up about 2% - futures only, not a session
Federal parliament opens its final sitting week of 2026, sitting to Thursday

cards.body: Seoul opened 4,734.90, down 2.77%, and slid to 4,673.05 by 01:27 UTC (low 4,670.23). The W10.76tn fund was readied Sunday - it has NOT bought.
cards.headline: KOSPI slides 4.04% Monday

cards.body: LIVE, in progress - no result yet. NZ 368 and 181-5 (79.3 ov); India need 5 wickets. Sunday's 720-9 sits in DATE CHECK below.
cards.headline: NZ 181-5, trail by 171

cards.body: The strike was Sunday. Monday: 6 dead; Davyd rescued alive after about 14 hours. Search goes on.
cards.headline: Dymer toll 6 - boy, 7, rescued

cards.body: Flash composite PMI 46.1, down from 48.2. Services 46.2, manufacturing 48.7. Lowest since Aug 2021; flash estimate.
cards.headline: Aus flash PMI falls to 46.1

cards.body: Q3 retail volumes rose 2.2% quarter on quarter, against a 0.5% forecast. Sales excluding autos rose 1.4%.
cards.headline: NZ retail jumps 2.2% in Q3

cards.body: Taylor leads as preferred PM for the first time in the Monday Newspoll. Albanese's net approval is -31.
cards.headline: Albanese trails Taylor in poll

cards.body: Bitcoin read $60,956.84 at 01:22 UTC Monday, holding in Asia trade after Saturday's $55,130 low. Timestamped read.
cards.headline: Bitcoin holds above $60,000

cards.body: Ian 'Molly' Meldrum died at 05:30 Monday in Melbourne, aged 83, his family said. He championed Australian music.
cards.headline: Molly Meldrum dies at 83
